changes: The LCD zoom now refreshes from the live WebGL output every animation frame at the destination device-pixel resolution, keeping gameplay moving and the enlarged image sharp.
Border width, outline, radius, shadow, and background now interpolate with the LCD, removing the bezel mismatch and final snap.
Paused transitions retain their pause icon, while a top-painted inner bezel guard prevents the outermost LCD fragment from leaking through the thin black edge.
